mentions.name: Socratix
mentions.description: This AI tutor builds a curriculum as a DAG of prerequisite concepts and unlocks the next concept only after the learner proves knowledge of the former through practice, diagnostics, and verbal examination — an AI voice examiner challenges them to justify their answers vocally.
mentions.problem: Choosing quiz answers makes it easy to fake knowledge; being required to vocally explain your thoughts makes faking knowledge significantly harder, and oral examination as a knowledge-verification measure seems underestimated compared with quizzes.
mentions.audience: Learners who study concepts through an AI tutor.
mentions.source_excerpt: Socratix (https://socratix-nine.vercel.app) - an AI tutor which constructs a curriculum as a DAG of prerequisite concepts, and unlocks the next concept only after you've proven your knowledge of the former concept by practicing, diagnostic, and now verbal examination through voice by an AI examiner who challenges you to justify yourself vocally.
mentions.author: rearview
